State columns with exit criteria: Backlog (acceptance criteria written), Ready (owner and branch/worktree assigned), Running (handoff artifact and changed files exist), Review (tests, diff review, risk check pass), Blocked (blocker has owner and next action), Merged (PR merged or local main updated), Archived (reason recorded). Kanban columns: Backlog, Ready, Running, Review, Blocked, Merged, Archived. Each agent as teammate with narrow contract: Owner (accountable), Scope (files, branch, tool surface, forbidden areas), State, Evidence (tests, screenshots, logs, review notes, eval reports), Merge gate (exact condition for integration).
